candidate.title: Legacy DOC piece-table expansion has no decoded-character budget
candidate.originalEvidence: Baseline candidate: src/legacy_doc.rs read() 180-197 calls main_text before any resource admission; pieces() accepts repeated physical fc ranges with contiguous increasing CPs (1088-1105), and main_text loops every declared CP and pushes StoryChar (1187-1219). Thousands of pieces can each reference the same ~1MiB WordDocument bytes, yielding billions of characters from ~1MiB input, exhausting host memory. CLI convert invokes doc_to_docx directly at src/bin/jubarte.rs:3129-3131 before DOCX admission.

candidate.title: HTML colspan expands without output budget
candidate.originalEvidence: Confirmed source-backed candidate: src/convert/altchunk.rs accepts arbitrary usize HTML colspan (around 567-572), sums spans and serializes one <w:gridCol> per logical column (481-505). A tiny internal HTML altChunk with colspan=1000000000 forces ~20 GB generated XML before DOM parsing. Public with_layout admits package then expands at mod.rs:773-800, no output budget.
